business_problem: De Beers Group needed a trusted way to prove diamond provenance and authenticity across a fragmented global supply chain where manual tracking made ethical sourcing, transparency, and participant coordination difficult at scale.
solution_summary: Accenture supported De Beers Group in building and scaling Tracr, a blockchain-based provenance platform for diamonds that combines digital identities, AI, IoT, and cloud infrastructure. Diamonds are registered at the producer level and assigned unique digital identities capturing attributes such as carat, clarity, color, cut, and origin. As stones move from rough to polished, those identities are updated across the blockchain to create a tamper-resistant chain of custody. AI and IoT support automated matching, quality checks, and higher-integrity data handling, while cloud computing provides the storage and processing capacity needed for global participant access. Accenture also helped restructure the technical team, establish governance, and improve the ingestion and processing architecture so the platform could scale. The result is an operational traceability system that gives industry participants a shared record of provenance from source to store.
